title: Brown's Owen's River Campground

services.name: Keoughs Campground
services.desc: The Keoughs campground is located alongside the Keoughs Hot Springs. We have 10 water and electric sites featuring 30amp electric service. These sites are nestled among the foothills of the Eastern Sierra and local trees and most are on well maintained grass. We also have a number of Dry camping sites available. Two week (14 day) maximum stay. Use of generators is not permitted in the park. Fire pits are not supplied for these sites at this time, use of your own above ground fire pit is permitted. Campers receive a discounted admission to the natural hot springs pool. Facilities: Electricity, water, hot showers (Keoughs campers only $2) snack bar. Handicapped facilities. Recreation Areas:
